metadata.description: Curated Claude Code + Codex CLI skills for the Aetheris Solutions agency workflow. Ships /aetheris-review (multi-agent PR review with Aetheris admin ticket integration) /second-opinion (read-only Codex CLI fresh-perspective review), and /fable-orchestrator (orchestrator-as-team-lead playbook for dispatching Opus/Sonnet/Codex agents), and grows as the team standardises shared workflows.

plugins.name: aetheris
plugins.description: Aetheris Solutions agency skills. /aetheris-review: multi-agent PR review with ticket integration — auto-detects the project from the repo URL via the aetheris-admin MCP, injects ticket acceptance criteria into every review agent, tiers findings into blocker / before-merge comments, and posts per-ticket findings back to Aetheris. /second-opinion: an independent, read-only Codex CLI review for a fresh perspective from a different model — either a code change (diff/branch/commit) or a plan/spec/design doc before it's built (--plan). Advisory only, never edits, report saved outside the repo. /fable-orchestrator: the agent-team pattern — the orchestrator model stays lean and routes builds to Opus/Sonnet agents with hard file-ownership matrices, interface contracts for parallel work, independent verification, and a two-round (same-model + Codex) review pipeline.
